title: Weekly legislative activity report
description: Writes a 150–250 word nonpartisan, wire-service-style summary of a legislator's bills for a reporting period.

variables.name: billTitlesContent
variables.description: Bill titles with dates and sponsor/cosponsor role, one per line.

surfaces: process-war-refresh edge function (weekly summaries on Home → Federal representatives)

usage.notes: The system prompt is also displayed verbatim to users as a transparency disclosure.
